2. **Video Description**: Below the posting options, there is a text field prompting the user to "Say something about this video..." where they can add a description or caption for the video.
3. **Video Preview**: The main part of the screen shows a preview of the video, which features a bun inside an oven. There is a play button in the center to play the video.
4. **Edit Option**: There is an "Edit" button on the bottom left corner of the video preview, allowing the user to make changes to the video before posting.
